args.title: 2. ooa.desktop_ui/object_action - type, click and read back

args.text: Desktop object action does one thing to a captured control: set the text box, click Save, read the label the button changed, tick the check box, pick a list item.

arguments: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $f = New-Object Windows.Forms.Form; $f.Text = 'UT objects window'; $f.Width = 460; $f.Height = 320; $f.StartPosition = 'CenterScreen'; $l = New-Object Windows.Forms.Label; $l.Name = 'status'; $l.Text = 'Ready'; $l.SetBounds(10, 10, 300, 20); $f.Controls.Add($l); $t = New-Object Windows.Forms.TextBox; $t.Name = 'customer'; $t.SetBounds(10, 40, 200, 24); $f.Controls.Add($t); $c = New-Object Windows.Forms.CheckBox; $c.Name = 'urgent'; $c.Text = 'Urgent'; $c.SetBounds(10, 70, 120, 24); $f.Controls.Add($c); $d = New-Object Windows.Forms.ComboBox; $d.Name = 'colour'; $d.DropDownStyle = 'DropDownList'; [void]$d.Items.AddRange(@('Red','Green','Blue')); $d.SetBounds(10, 100, 120, 24); $f.Controls.Add($d); $b = New-Object Windows.Forms.Button; $b.Name = 'save'; $b.Text = 'Save'; $b.SetBounds(220, 40, 80, 26); $b.Add_Click({ $l.Text = 'Saved ' + $t.Text }); $f.Controls.Add($b); $g = New-Object Windows.Forms.DataGridView; $g.Name = 'people'; $g.SetBounds(10, 140, 400, 120); $g.AllowUserToAddRows = $false; [void]$g.Columns.Add('Name', 'Name'); [void]$g.Columns.Add('City', 'City'); [void]$g.Rows.Add('Ann', 'Oslo'); [void]$g.Rows.Add('Bob', 'Rome'); $f.Controls.Add($g); [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run($f)
